description_en: A Yemeni/Middle Eastern restaurant run by a Yemeni chef and his Korean wife, serving mandi rice, kebab wraps, hummus and falafel, with a separately labelled vegan section and a prayer room.
near_spot: Old downtown (Dongmun Market / Gwandeokjeong, Tapdong-Chilseong-ro side)
closed_days: Wednesday (per Visit Jeju Muslim-friendly guide; HappyCow and Traveloka list different days, so confirm)
solo_ok_evidence: Menu is individually priced single plates (wraps 11,000 KRW, mandi rice with chicken 16,000 KRW); ordering is per item on a table tablet. No review explicitly mentions solo diners.
notes: Covers halal + vegan + English menu. Listed in Visit Jeju's Muslim-traveler restaurant guide; HappyCow says it serves halal food and has a prayer room. Traveloka/Wanderlog claim formal halal certification, but I could not confirm this on an official certifier list, so marked muslim_friendly. HappyCow reviews from Oct 2026 confirm it is operating and mention the English menu and vegan section. Phone 0504-3139-6652 (Polle and Visit Jeju). Coordinates from HappyCow (listing last edited 2021). Mandi chicken allergens not published.

description_en: A small Thai-owned restaurant near Yongduam serving pad thai, rice-noodle soups and curries, where staff will make most dishes vegan on request.
solo_ok_evidence: Single-dish noodle and rice plates priced individually at 8,000-9,800 KRW (pad thai, pho, kuay teow tom yum).
signature_menu_en: Pad Thai (팟타이 / 태국식 볶음국수) - 8,000-8,800 KRW (sources differ)
notes: This is the vegan-option pick. HappyCow and Spinach Guide say the owners understand veganism, there is a labelled vegan menu, and almost everything can be made without fish sauce. DiningCode also tags it 비건옵션가능. Spinach Guide gives the address as 용화로 14-2, but DiningCode (road address plus lot 616-72, matching HappyCow) and Harper's Bazaar Korea give 용화로 41-2, which I used. A DiningCode blog post describes a July 2026 visit, so it appears to be operating. Hours differ between sources. I found no confirmation of an English menu; reviewers say staff are English-friendly. Pad thai allergens (egg, peanut, fish sauce) vary by order and are not published. Phone 064-747-3676.

description_en: A famous local soup house known for its thick Jeju-style bracken (gosari) and beef soup and for momguk seaweed-pork soup, served by the bowl from early morning.
near_spot: Gwandeokjeong / old downtown (also walkable toward Yongduam)
closed_days: Listed as open year-round (연중무휴); holiday closures not confirmed
solo_ok_evidence: Every soup is sold by the single bowl (고사리육개장, 사골해장국, 몸국 at 11,000 KRW each). No review explicitly mentions solo diners.
allergens: beef (main ingredient); full allergen list not published
notes: This is the Jeju-specialty pick. Prices are from Polle (11,000 KRW); older sources say 10,000. Google reviews from Feb-Jul 2026 on Wanderlog confirm it is operating. Expect long queues at peak times; no reservations. The English menu is unconfirmed: Wanderlog says staff help translate, while one April 2026 reviewer says staff speak very limited English. Momguk contains pork, so marked not halal. Phone 064-757-3393.

description_en: A long-running (since 2002) Jeju meat-noodle shop, now in a new building near Iho, known for pork-bone broth noodles topped with sliced boiled pork.
solo_ok_evidence: Gogi-guksu is sold by the bowl (10,000 KRW); waitlist and remote queueing via a kiosk and the CatchTable app.
allergens: wheat, pork (main ingredients); full allergen list not published
notes: This is the meat-noodle pick. The shop moved from Samseong-ro to this Iho address; some English guides still list 삼성로 67. The Korea Tourism Organization record was registered in June 2025 and updated in March 2026, and Google and Polle reviews from 2026 confirm it is open. Prices: Polle lists 10,000 KRW, another source 9,500. The KTO record has photos at tong.visitkorea.or.kr (e.g. https://tong.visitkorea.or.kr/cms/resource/03/3497603_image2_1.jpg), but I could not confirm their license type, so image_url is null. One English-language review mentions an English ordering system, but I could not verify it. Phone 064-746-2222.

description_en: A large bakery café right on Hamdeok Beach, with sea-view terrace seating and coffee and pastries made with Jeju ingredients.
solo_ok_evidence: Counter-order café selling single drinks (Americano 7,000 KRW) and individual pastries (5,000-6,500 KRW).
allergens: milk (cream-topped coffee); full allergen list not published
notes: Prices are from Polle (Americano 7,000, Udo peanut latte 9,000). NOL World lists a lower Americano price (6,000), so prices may have risen. Polle reviews from early November 2026 confirm it is open. Hours (06:00-24:00) come from a KTO record last updated September 2025. Reviewers call it pricey but praise the view. Plant milk and vegan bakes are unconfirmed. Phone 064-702-0007. Bread comes out at set times.

description_en: A busy local snack shop near Halla University known for cold yeolmu (young radish kimchi) noodles and anchovy-chili gimbap, with cheap single-portion dishes.
near_spot: Halla Arboretum / Nohyeong (about 2 km from Halla Arboretum)
solo_ok_evidence: Bunsik menu of individually priced single portions (gimbap rolls 4,500-5,500 KRW, noodle bowls 9,500-10,000 KRW); takeout also available.
allergens: wheat (noodles); full allergen list not published
notes: This is the cheap Nohyeong pick. Hours and closed day come from the KTO record (updated June 2025). A June 2026 blog post and a Polle review from about 18 days ago confirm it is open. Expect lunchtime queues, hard parking, and an entrance at the back of the building. Menu includes ham gimbap, so marked not halal. Coordinates: no map listing found, so lat/lng are null. KTO photos exist at tong.visitkorea.or.kr (e.g. https://tong.visitkorea.or.kr/cms/resource/63/2870863_image2_1.jpg) but their license is unconfirmed. Phone 064-748-2654.

description_en: A quiet café in a converted old house with a hanok-style garden off Chilseong-ro, serving traditional teas, yakgwa and other Korean desserts, and coffee.
near_spot: Dongmun Market / old downtown (Chilseong-ro shopping street)
solo_ok_evidence: Café with single drinks (Americano 4,000 KRW) and individual desserts (yakgwa 2,000 KRW, cheese-persimmon roll 4,500 KRW).
signature_menu_en: Chilseong Latte (칠성라떼, drinking-yogurt drink with house lemon syrup) - 6,500 KRW
allergens: milk (yogurt-based); full allergen list not published
notes: Status uncertain: the Visit Jeju and KTO listings were updated in September 2026, but the newest user reviews I found are about two years old, so confirm it is still open before relying on it. Pet-friendly, no parking, and the entrance is easy to miss (wooden door, then a garden path). Prices are from Polle and may be outdated. Visit Jeju photos are marked 'All rights reserved', so no image is included. Phone 010-6605-0953.
